instruction: A mirror-still alpine lake at morning: snow-capped peaks reflected in the water, a shoreline of pines and boulders, a wooden rowboat tied to a small dock, a log cabin with smoking chimney, a campfire ring, wildflowers in the meadow grass, and mist lifting off the lake surface as ripples spread from the drifting boat.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Alpine Lake Shore. A mirror-still alpine lake at morning: snow-capped peaks reflected in the water, a shoreline of pines and boulders, a wooden rowboat tied to a small dock, a log cabin with smoking chimney, a campfire ring, wildflowers in the meadow grass, and mist lifting off the lake surface as ripples spread from the drifting boat. Style: crisp stylized realism. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
